newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
Sales reported on 10,700 slaughter steers and 5,400 heifers; 40,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,800 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 72.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-4 1100 lbs including heiferettes 65.00.
Wk to Date - 40,000 Week Ago - 192,700 Year Ago - 92,900
